verdict.rationale: Stable publishes per-endpoint API reference pages under docs.usestable.com/reference, but nothing in the evidence shows they are interactive or include runnable examples (no 'try it' console, no executable snippets). The OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is also no machine-readable spec to back a playground. A static reference is an adjacent feature and does not earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
